thread:
support-sally: @eng-runtime @eng-sre SOC-1253 customer hitting p99 spikes (6s -> 18s) after billing service deploy. They also see repeated 401s and retries that align with GPU OOMs on the tenant's hosts. Sending logs and quick repro steps.

eng-runtime-miguel: Can you paste the tenant id and a sample request? I want to check model variant routing and KV sizes.

support-sally: tenant=acme-inc, route=/v1/generate, model=redwood-13b-q4f32, sample prompt attached. p95=1.2s p99=18.3s over last 10m. Errors: intermittent 401 then many 429 retries. Logs:
```
2026-03-16T21:04:12Z ERROR auth: token verify failed for key=k_abc status=401
2026-03-16T21:04:14Z WARN runtime: request retry=1 tenant=acme-inc host=gpu-07 kv_size=3.2GB
2026-03-16T21:04:15Z ERROR runtime: GPU_OOM allocating kv cache growth size=128MB slab_free=0.9GB
```

eng-sre-aly: Noted. Is this after the billing rollout? @billing-tara deployed the new billing auth token refresh yesterday.

billing-tara: Yes, we rolled out token rotation patch at 20:50 UTC. No infra changes otherwise. Watching for auth flakiness now.

ml-ops-jin: Observed KV growth on acme tenants earlier. Could be prefix caching disabled -> huge per-req KV. Can you check request size distribution? Also which allocator flags are active on gpu-07?

support-sally: Request lengths aren't bigger than normal. Allocator flags on gpu-07: --kv-evict-threshold=0.6 --slab-compact=on --alloc-strategy=best-fit

eng-runtime-miguel: That evict threshold is pretty low and with compaction on we might be fragmenting. Two quick mitigations: 1) increase kv-evict-threshold to 0.8 for the host group, 2) enable soft-evict for long prefixes. Will open a canary rollout to acme's host pool.

eng-sre-aly: I'll put gpu-07 into maintenance mode to stop noisy retries and route traffic away. Also will apply emergency DNS-route to a lower-capacity fallback model (redwood-7b) for impacted keys.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0316-001 assigned to eng-runtime-miguel, eng-sre-aly

ml-ops-jin: For repro: run this locally to stress KV growth:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"<long_prefix>...","max_tokens":512}'; done
```
Watch /metrics for kv_cache_bytes and slab_free.

support-sally: Customer on call at 22:30 UTC. They want temporary SLA relief and we're proposing fallback + token refresh rollback if auth continues to fail. Billing, can we offer credit while we triage?

billing-tara: I'll approve a manual goodwill credit for acme-inc and pause automated billing alerts until resolved.

eng-runtime-miguel: Action items: (A) canary change evict-threshold->0.8 on acme host pool now, (B) enable soft-evict, (C) roll routing to redwood-7b fallback for p99-sensitive requests, (D) capture heapshot from gpu-07 and KV heatmap. I'll post small rollout PR in a minute.

eng-sre-aly: Done: gpu-07 removed from pool, fallback routing active for tenant=acme-inc. Observed tail latency drop to p99=3.5s in 1min. Will keep monitoring.

support-sally: Thanks team — I'll update customer and join call. Please paste PR/link and heapshot when available.

eng-runtime-miguel: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/changes/1859 diff: increases evict threshold and soft-evict toggle. Heapshot: s3://redwood-debug/gpu-07/heapshot-7721112222.log

support-sally: Customer confirmed improved p99 to ~3s after fallback. Will leave thread open until post-mortem. :white_check_mark:
